missing_claims.evidence: Defining article, supplements, Clark preprint, Smart-seq2 2013/2014, scBS-seq, scM&T-seq and G&T-seq originals now have two located readers. The cited G&T 2015 original prints an AC TSO, while the 2014 Smart-seq2 and 2016 detailed G&T protocols print ACAT; Clark names Exiqon TSO without identifying which ordered variant and names only an iTAG family. Selection remains unresolved and no absence is accepted.

conclusion: The publisher MOESM2–6 attachments and Picelli 2013 Supplementary Table 2 now each have two located independent original-source reads. The attachments do not provide Clark’s selected TSO or iTAG sequence; Picelli’s table documents multiple TSO variants and cannot select one for Clark. The defining paper, preprint and inherited Smart-seq2, scBS-seq, scM&T-seq and G&T-seq sources likewise have two passes. Clark’s Exiqon TSO variant and iTAG well remain unverified; no missing-information claim is accepted.
